scientific_integrity: Theorem is proved analytically from moment-matrix positivity and finite-rank Schur complements. The packaged Python/SymPy checks validate algebraic identities and representative finite sections, but cannot certify the infinite-dimensional claims or establish historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Two independently varied initial squared weights of the Bergman-tail unilateral weighted shift only; no later-weight perturbations, no general nonlinear perturbations, and no order-asymptotic uniformity near c=1 is asserted. An equivalent historical two-parameter formula may exist.
title: Exact finite-order weak-subnormality windows for two initial Bergman-shift weights
